services.name: Supabase Realtime
services.purpose: Live cross-device token sync for Session 2 battle maps
services.note: Anon/publishable key hardcoded in HTML (intentional for browser use). Project must exist with Realtime enabled.

services.name: MapTiler
services.purpose: Map tiles for generated location HTML pages
services.note: MAPTILER_KEY is local-run only — not injected in CI. Custom style is commented out (marked TEMP) — will break if account or style is deleted.

services.name: Mapbox
services.purpose: Account-owned map style (referenced in EXTERNAL_TOOLS.md; not yet in production code)

services.name: OSRM
services.purpose: Road/path route snapping for map overlays (build-time utility only, no API key required)

services.name: GitHub Actions
services.purpose: Auto-regenerates docs/ HTML on push to main and commits back to repo
services.note: Requires contents:write permission on repo. Does not inject MAPTILER_KEY — CI-built pages lack map tiles.
